comments.text:
The Ilya thing is similar to what I was thinking earlier, language could be described as the "matter" of cognition (or at least an abstraction layer above it) and it's the very thing we use in our conscious interpretation of the world relayed to us by our senses, not to mention that language is how we exchange ideas with others, constructing trends and the "public consciousness". I think LLMs are a very significant milestone.

The voice in the head thing is great in the right hands (e.g. qualified mental health professionals acting in your best interest), but I could absolutely see research eventually showing that hijacking this could quite significantly influence people through suggestion. The scary part isn't a sudden AI message saying "They're all against you! Kill them all!" but instead a slow-burn, long-term, subtle inclusion of language to gradually guide you towards a particular way of thinking. Remember how FB was caught a couple of times doing psychological experiments on their users by e.g. showing content to make people feel a certain way? Yeah, you should NOT trust this technology if offered it by companies, and DEFINITELY not if offered it by the government.

comments.author: @ErikdeBruijn
comments.text: Being able to predict the next word well requires it to predict it according to a world model that's consistent with how a subset of people generally appear to look at the world, based on the way they describe it in their texts used during training. This could be describing phenomena, knowledge. Some of this knowledge are "recipes" use to reason about he world. However, when trying to get great results in validation, we see that it's garbage in equals garbage out. So it becomes a matter of curating processed to arrive at high quality inputs. So the question becomes, whose world views do we train on. I think these processes themselves are highly interesting and could be a group effort of humanity that is crowd sourced in a more balanced and diverse way as well. Just like neurodiversity is beneficial in groups, we want our LLM models to be neurodiverse to be more robust.

(Don't get me wrong, GPT-4 is the best model when compared to other)

Just as an example, I asked about Energy density of Hydrogen, Methane and Gasoline in kWh/L unit.

Let say It gave me the answer,
Gasoline - 12kWh/L
Hydrogen - 3 kWh/L
(I don't remember the exact value, its just an example )

After this I got really confused, because even thou Hydrogen is a gas it has only 1/4th the energy density of Gasoline which is a liquid (therefore more dense and heavy)

It means, 4L of Hydrogen will have same energy as 1L of Gasoline.
(I got really exited by that, because we can then easily swith to Hydrogen from Gasoline, as storing Hydrogen will be not a issue, we just need 4 times the volume of tank, which is not that much)

So we will need far far bigger tank to store similar energy as 1L of Gasoline, or Pressurize it or liquify it.

comments.author: @Wizardess
comments.text:
The "Predicting the next word" with Ilya Sutskever placed two concepts together to see how predicting the next word must work, in humans and AI apparatus.

If you do not know the context it is impossible to predict the next _______. Do I mean word? Do I mean automobile brand I will see? Do I mean term in the equation? This is simpler if you know the situation, the setting in which the statement is made. You know of you are an architect talking business from the setting. The AI needs a prompt, "You are a world renowned  architect." Bob's your uncle. With background information the problem is soluble. With AI, AGI, anything less than an all knowing God, or blind luck the "prompt" is required and the better the prompt the better the results. This is true for humans and AIs, especially AIs with very limited working memory that it has not learned how to manage properly, yet.

We will have reached an important step when we can leave Cathy, our personal AI assistant, for a day or two, come back, and resume a conversation without knowing if "Cathy" is a human or a computer. (This includes missing the guess on WHICH conversation we are resuming from time to time.)

Another thing I am wondering about here is "how does an AI forget something it learned and has since found to be false?" That is another valuable HI ability.

comments.author: @brytonkalyi277
comments.text: °∆ I believe we are meant to be like Jesus in our hearts and not in our flesh. But be careful of AI, for it is just our flesh and that is it. It knows only things of the flesh (our fleshly desires) and cannot comprehend things of the spirit such as peace of heart (which comes from obeying God's Word). Whereas we are a spirit and we have a soul but live in the body (in the flesh). When you go to bed it is your flesh that sleeps but your spirit never sleeps (otherwise you have died physically) that is why you have dreams. More so, true love that endures and last is a thing of the heart (when I say 'heart', I mean 'spirit'). But fake love, pretentious love, love with expectations, love for classic reasons, love for material reasons and love for selfish reasons that is a thing of our flesh. In the beginning God said let us make man in our own image, according to our likeness. Take note, God is Spirit and God is Love. As Love He is the source of it. We also know that God is Omnipotent, for He creates out of nothing and He has no beginning and has no end. That means, our love is but a shadow of God's Love. True love looks around to see who is in need of your help, your smile, your possessions, your money, your strength, your quality time. Love forgives and forgets. Love wants for others what it wants for itself. Take note, true love works in conjunction with other spiritual forces such as patience and faith (in the finished work of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ, rather than in what man has done such as science, technology and organizations which won't last forever). To avoid sin and error which leads to the death of our body and also our spirit in hell fire, we should let the Word of God be the standard of our lives not AI. If not, God will let us face AI on our own and it will cast the truth down to the ground, it will be the cause of so much destruction like never seen before, it will deceive many and take many captive in order to enslave them into worshipping it and abiding in lawlessness. We can only destroy ourselves but with God all things are possible. God knows us better because He is our Creater and He knows our beginning and our end. Our prove text is taken from the book of John 5:31-44, 2 Thessalonians 2:1-12, Daniel 2, Daniel 7-9, Revelation 13-15, Matthew 24-25 and Luke 21. Let us watch and pray... God bless you as you share this message to others.
